trips.route_note: Take the S2 S-Bahn from Munich Hauptbahnhof or Marienplatz directly to Dachau station, then a short local bus (726) to the memorial site.
see: Old Town and Dachau Palace gardens
trips.tour_query: Dachau memorial day trip from Munich
trips.why: The S-Bahn reaches Dachau station in about 10 minutes with frequent service, then a short local bus to the memorial.
know: The memorial site is closed on certain days, so check opening days before going
Allow several hours to see the grounds and exhibitions properly

bus.via: Munich central bus station to Garmisch-Partenkirchen station

trips.route_note: Direct regional trains run from Munich Hauptbahnhof to Garmisch-Partenkirchen, then the Zugspitzbahn or a bus takes you up to the Zugspitze or Partnachklamm.
trips.why: Direct regional trains take about 1h 9m with frequent departures, far better than driving or a costly taxi.
know: Book Zugspitze tickets ahead in peak season
Mountain weather changes fast, so bring layers even in summer
